title: Freakonomics
author: Steven D. Levitt
summary: Economist Steven Levitt and journalist Stephen Dubner apply economic thinking to unexpected questions, such as cheating teachers, drug dealers and the effect of names. The book looks at how incentives shape behaviour.
readIf: you like curious, counterintuitive questions answered with data.
skipIf: you want a systematic introduction to economics or are wary of some of its contested claims.
